name: gen-wasm-demo
description: Standalone in-browser terminal for testing the gen wasm32-unknown-emscripten build, built on @jupyterlite/cockle

scripts.postbuild:copy-assets: copyfiles -u 1 assets/* dist/ && cp cockle-config.json dist/ && mkdir -p dist/gen dist/cockle_fs dist/coreutils dist/grep dist/less dist/sed && cp gen-wasm/* dist/gen/ && cp cockle_fs-wasm/* dist/cockle_fs/ && cp coreutils-wasm/* dist/coreutils/ && cp grep-wasm/* dist/grep/ && cp less-wasm/* dist/less/ && cp sed-wasm/* dist/sed/
